title: L¹ mollification error of an indicator controlled by its translation modulus
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let F ⊆ ℝ^N be L^N-null-measurable, and let ρ : ℝ^N → ℝ be continuous with compact support, ρ ≥ 0 and ∫ρ dL^N = 1. Let σ, R, C ∈ ℝ with C ≥ 0 and support ρ ⊆ B̄_σ(0). Write S_h := {y : y + h ∈ S} and B_R := B_R(0) (open ball). Assume L^N(B_R ∩ (F_h Δ F)) ≤ ofReal(C|h|) for every h ∈ ℝ^N with |h| ≤ σ. Then ∫⁻_{B_R} ofReal|∫_F ρ(y − z) dz − 1_F(y)| dy ≤ ofReal(σC). Here ∫_F ρ(y − z) dz is the integral with respect to the restricted measure L^N⌞F, and ∫⁻ is the [0, ∞]-valued Lebesgue integral.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : Set (Rn N)) (ρ : Rn N → ℝ) (σ R C : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet F volume → Continuous ρ → HasCompactSupport ρ → (∀ y, 0 ≤ ρ y) → ∫ y, ρ y = 1 → Function.support ρ ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : Rn N) σ → 0 ≤ C → (∀ h : Rn N, ‖h‖ ≤ σ → volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R ∩ symmDiff ((fun y ↦ y + h) ⁻¹' F) F) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ‖h‖)) → ∫⁻ y in Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R, ENNReal.ofReal |(∫ z in F, ρ (y - z)) - F.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) y| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (σ * C)
